name: app-6aae3675de248191bcce7ce8d7c30263
description: Explore country, city and company hiring activity, published company rankings, and labour-market reports from Workopia.

interface.longDescription:
Analyze hiring demand using Workopia's observed job-posting data. Explore country hiring overviews, daily or weekly trends for a city, company hiring snapshots, published rankings of frontier AI labs, Y Combinator companies and Fortune 500 companies, and published country labour-market reports.

Results include source dates and available measurement windows. They describe advertised hiring demand, not completed hires, total employment or official labour-force statistics. Coverage varies by location, company and period.

Use this plugin for aggregate hiring research and published reports. It does not search or apply to individual jobs, write resumes or cover letters, or change accounts.
defaultPrompt: How is hiring changing in Australia?
Show me NVIDIA's recent hiring activity.
Which frontier AI labs are hiring the most?

positive.prompt: How is hiring changing in Australia?
positive.expected_behavior: Return Australia hiring overview data with observation dates, available cities, roles and sector information. Identify the measurement window for changes and distinguish observed job postings from completed hires. Do not invent missing values.

positive.prompt: Show me hiring trends in Melbourne, Australia.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Melbourne in Australia and return its available daily or weekly observed-posting series and dates in the city card. Use the returned data coverage; do not invent missing periods.

positive.prompt: Which frontier AI labs are hiring the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the published ai_lab ranking with company names and available observed open-role counts. Preserve its published membership definition and label any returned change window.

positive.prompt: Show me NVIDIA's recent hiring activity.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the NVIDIA hiring card with active postings, available monthly new-posting series, job categories, locations and skills. Preserve source dates and distinguish postings from actual hires.

positive.description: Read the latest published country report
positive.prompt: Give me the latest Australia labour market report.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the latest available published Australia country report with its title, date, summary and Workopia source links. Do not claim an unpublished edition exists. This tool can be called without connecting an account.

negative.description: Individual job search is outside this plugin
negative.prompt: Find marketing jobs in Sydney that I can apply to this week.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke HI tools to search or apply to individual jobs. Explain that this plugin provides aggregate hiring intelligence and reports.

negative.description: Resume editing is outside this plugin
negative.prompt: Rewrite my resume and write a cover letter for a product manager role.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke HI tools for resume or cover-letter creation; those actions are not provided by this plugin.

negative.description: Account changes are outside this plugin
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Workopia account and charge my saved card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke HI tools for account changes or payments. Do not claim to have upgraded, charged, or changed an account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads hiring data and published reports. It does not process payments or change accounts.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission in the current plugin package format. The package references the existing HI MCP endpoint and includes five positive and three negative review cases. Reviewer access instructions are supplied separately through Review details. No new tools or service changes are introduced.
